name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-lip-and-lap
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Lip and Lap
description:
POST-C3 2023 SUMMER SUBMISSION

Lip and Lap are two NPCs from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. These sprites are meant to be used with wye's NPC sprites . The colors are easily arranged to be easy to recolor them. I already included some extension field configurations in a text file, so it is easier to test the sprite.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
